climate_pressure: Heavy rain, landslides, flash floods and severe weather in Cox's Bazar.
documented_impact: Reported shelter and infrastructure damage and repeated displacement in refugee camps.
fcv_mediator: Forced-displacement settings combine crowded temporary hillside shelters, restricted mobility, degraded slopes and limited services.
possible_consequence: These conditions narrow safe evacuation and coping options and magnify weather-related losses; they do not establish climate-caused refugee-host violence.
geographies: Cox's Bazar camps and adjacent host communities
alternative_explanations: Site design, poverty, infrastructure and service gaps shape losses independently of the displacement history; individual contributions are not measured.
uncertainty: Conditional reverse interaction grounded in camp context and dated July 2026 impacts, not a causal estimate or attribution of a weather event to climate change.
resilience_factors: Reported warning/gauge capacity and planned inclusive training may support preparedness; performance and access were not independently evaluated.
compact_statement: Displacement-related settlement and mobility constraints in Cox's Bazar magnify vulnerability to heavy rain, landslides and flooding, without implying climate-driven violence.
